title: China’s Benchmark Power-Station Coal Price to Stay Flat in 2026
summary: China’s long-term benchmark power-station coal price for 2026 has been set at the same level as this year, according to traders with knowledge of the matter.

title: Copper Trades Near Record as US Stockpiling Spurs Supply Crunch
summary: Copper traded near an all-time high, as investors bet on a sustained rally spurred by the US stockpiling and tight global supply.
